prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Latina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver ship's anchor, a bronze barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum bracelets. Extra long nails in matching polished black granite.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished black granite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID silver mineral fleck detail glinting through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved black granite.

LEFT Cracks: the black granite body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left shoulder, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right upper arm and one at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the raw rough dull grey stone with a coarse speckled grain and no polish inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the black granite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: both hands clasped behind her lower back, shoulders back, one foot crossed in front of the other.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme peep-toe platform stiletto pumps in cream white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved black granite right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth golden-tan skin, a confident smirk, soft pastel-peach hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a copper small flared temple bell, a silver round bell, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, an iron small flared temple bell, an iron square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold hair ornaments. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved jade-green stone.

Everywhere else, including his chest, the jade-green stone is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
